title: 08. Files & Errors: SUBPROCESS & SYSTEM INTERACTION
summary: SUBPROCESS & SYSTEM INTERACTION: SUBPROCESS — Run External Commands from Python; Basic usage (preferred method).

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```python name=advanced/subprocess_system.py
# ============================================================
# SUBPROCESS — Run External Commands from Python
# ============================================================
import subprocess
import shlex

# --- Basic usage (preferred method) ---
result = subprocess.run(
    ["ls", "-la", "/tmp"],
    capture_output=True,    # Capture stdout and stderr
    text=True,              # Return strings instead of bytes
    timeout=30,             # Timeout in seconds
    check=True,             # Raise CalledProcessError on non-zero exit
)
print(result.stdout)
print(result.stderr)
print(result.returncode)   # 0 = success

# --- With shell=True (use cautiously — security risk!) ---
result = subprocess.run(
    "echo $HOME && ls | head -5",
    shell=True,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
)

# --- Pipe between commands ---
ps = subprocess.Popen(
    ["ps", "aux"],
    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
)
grep = subprocess.Popen(
    ["grep", "python"],
    stdin=ps.stdout,
    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
    text=True,
)
ps.stdout.close()
output = grep.communicate()[0]

# --- Send input to process ---
result = subprocess.run(
    ["python3", "-c", "name = input('Name: '); print(f'Hello, {name}!')"],
    input="Veera",
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
)

# --- Environment variables ---
import os
env = os.environ.copy()
env["MY_VAR"] = "my_value"
result = subprocess.run(["printenv", "MY_VAR"], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)

# --- Async subprocess ---
import asyncio

async def run_command(cmd: str):
    proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_shell(
        cmd,
        stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
    )
    stdout, stderr = await proc.communicate()
    return stdout.decode()

# ============================================================
# SYS MODULE
# ============================================================
import sys

print(sys.version)           # Python version
print(sys.platform)          # 'linux', 'darwin', 'win32'
print(sys.path)              # Module search paths
print(sys.argv)              # Command-line arguments
print(sys.getsizeof([]))     # Memory size of object in bytes
print(sys.getrecursionlimit())  # Default: 1000
sys.setrecursionlimit(5000)

# Stdin/Stdout/Stderr
sys.stdout.write("Hello\n")
sys.stderr.write("Error!\n")

# Exit
# sys.exit(0)   # Clean exit
# sys.exit(1)   # Error exit

# ============================================================
# PLATFORM MODULE
# ============================================================
import platform

print(platform.system())         # 'Linux', 'Darwin', 'Windows'
print(platform.python_version()) # '3.12.0'
print(platform.machine())        # 'x86_64', 'arm64'
print(platform.node())           # hostname
```
